# Y7 Logistics — Nationwide Auto Transport Broker

> Y7 Logistics is a US-based, FMCSA-licensed auto transport brokerage (USDOT #4427359, MC #1741537) connecting shippers with verified carriers across all 50 states. We specialize in auction pickups, dealer transport, and port delivery for international export. Multilingual support in English, Russian, Polish, and Ukrainian.

## About Y7 Logistics

- Licensed FMCSA broker (MC #1741537, USDOT #4427359)
- $75,000 surety bond (BMC-84)
- Central Dispatch verified, 90% of orders through CD
- Team with 10+ years combined auto transport experience
- Based in Newton, MA; operates nationwide

## Core Services

- [Ship My Car](https://www.y7agency.com/ship-my-car): Door-to-door auto transport for individuals, 50 states
- [Dealer Transport](https://www.y7agency.com/dealers): B2B transport for auto dealerships with volume pricing
- [Export & Port Delivery](https://www.y7agency.com/exporters): Auction-to-port and door-to-port delivery for international exporters
- [Auction Car Shipping](https://www.y7agency.com/auction-car-shipping): Copart, IAAI, Manheim pickup and delivery
- [Enclosed Car Shipping](https://www.y7agency.com/enclosed-car-shipping): Covered transport for luxury and classic vehicles
